fields.label: Shipping & Safe Delivery Policy
fields.name: global_shipping_policy
fields.instructions: Content displayed in the single product 'Shipping & Delivery' tab
fields.default_value:
All orders are carefully packed in multi-layer protective packaging with tamper-proof seal to ensure your sacred items reach you safely and auspiciously.

  • Standard Delivery: Delivered in 4–7 business days across India.
  • Express Dispatch: Dispatched within 24 hours of order confirmation.
  • Tracking Details: Real-time tracking link sent via SMS and Email once dispatched.

fields.label: Returns & Exchange Policy
fields.name: global_returns_policy
fields.instructions: Content displayed in the single product 'Returns & Exchange' tab
fields.default_value:
We take immense pride in the craftsmanship of our sacred items. If you receive a damaged or defective product, we offer a 100% replacement or refund.

  • 7-Day Replacement Window: Report any defect within 7 days of delivery with an unboxing video.
  • 100% Refund Assurance: Instant refund processed upon return pickup verification.
  • Customer Support: Contact our dedicated care team at support@bhaktirastore.com or WhatsApp.

fields.label: Global FAQs (Default for all products)
fields.name: global_product_faqs
fields.instructions: These FAQs will show on all products unless a product has its own custom FAQs entered.
